name: U-15 Under Fifteen
original_name: U-15 アンダーフィフティーン
source:
Take pictures of the timid little sister Shizuku and the cool and confident sister Miu. From old school swimsuits to competitive swimsuits, white school swimsuits and T-back bikini's, have them change in to various different clothes.

Take lots of lewd photographs! Even though it might be a bit embarrassing, just remember it's your job, so do your best!
